main_text.l: EPIGRAMMA G. G. L. E. Anno 1588. Octo-

l.i: Alpes Heluetiæ, & muris oppida cincta fuis:
Ergo non vinci potis est armisque virisque,
Vincam auro, Si auro vincitur Heluetia.
Ac subito mulos agit auro Hispanus onustos,
Quum subit, extemplo moenia lapsa ruunt.
O ferale omen! Pereant Hispanus & aurum,

page.notes: The woodcut drop cap B is joined to "Æticus" as "BÆticus". The ornamental border and the faint show-through from the reverse page are not transcribed. No running head is printed. Spelling and punctuation are kept as printed, including "inuictásque" and "Ac subito" with the printed accents.
